description: This file defines a fake resource manager for testing purposes within the Kubernetes API server, including interfaces, struct implementations, and methods for recording actions and validating expected behavior.

classes.name: fakeResourceManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of ResourceManager used for testing, recording actions and validating expected calls.

classes.name: recorderResourceManager
classes.description: A resource manager that records actions for testing purposes.

classes.name: recorderResourceManagerAction
classes.description: Represents a recorded action performed on the resource manager, including type, group, version, and value.

methods.name: Expect
methods.description: Returns the expected resource manager for setting expectations.

methods.name: HasExpectedNumberActions
methods.description: Checks if the number of actions recorded meets or exceeds the expected number.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates that the recorded actions match the expected actions.

methods.name: WaitForActions
methods.description: Waits until the expected number of actions are recorded or timeout occurs.

methods.name: SetGroupVersionPriority
methods.description: Records a call to set the priority of a group version.

methods.name: SetPeerDiscoveryProvider
methods.description: Records a call to set the peer discovery provider.

methods.name: AddGroupVersion
methods.description: Records a call to add a group version.

methods.name: RemoveGroup
methods.description: Records a call to remove a group.

methods.name: RemoveGroupVersion
methods.description: Records a call to remove a specific group version.

methods.name: SetGroups
methods.description: Records a call to set multiple API groups.

methods.name: WebService
methods.description: Unimplemented method to return a WebService.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Unimplemented method to handle HTTP requests.

methods.name: WithSource
methods.description: Unimplemented method to associate a source with the resource manager.

methods.name: AddInvalidationCallback
methods.description: Unimplemented method to add a callback for invalidation.
